lines.text: Use although or but, not both!
Many learners say: Although I am tired, but I keep working.
Better: Although I am tired, I keep working.
Use although or but, not both.
We! Although it was late, we stayed.

data.wrong: Although I am tired, but I keep working.
data.right: Although I am tired, I keep working.
data.why: Use although or but, not both.
